title: Surreal Battle Scene
description: A large green humanoid head with wide eyes and an open mouth emits blue energy beams and a long black-and-gold snake-dragon creature from its mouth. In the foreground on rolling green hills, three armored soldiers with root-like legs fire yellow energy blasts at each other while small colorful creatures and orbs are scattered around. A stained glass window in the upper right shows distorted screaming faces.
prompt: surreal fantasy painting of a giant bald green-skinned head with wide eyes and open mouth, a long black and gold snake dragon with dripping texture emerging from its mouth, three armored soldiers with tree root legs standing on rolling green hills firing bright yellow energy blasts at each other, small colorful blob creatures and orbs scattered on the hills, a stained glass window in the sky showing distorted screaming faces, chaotic energy beams and sparks, vibrant yet dark atmosphere
